from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Optional

class CompanyFinancialSnapshot(BaseModel):
    """A single company's Q1 2025 financial data extracted from one report."""
    company_name: str = Field(description="The full name of the company")
    stock_code: Optional[str] = Field(description="The stock code of the company, if available")
    period: str = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., '2025-Q1'")
    total_assets: float = Field(description="Total Assets at period end in CNY")
    net_profit_attributable: float = Field(description="Net Profit Attributable to Shareholders for the period in CNY")
    monetary_funds: float = Field(description="Monetary Funds at period end in CNY")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Top-level container aggregating all company financial snapshots."""
    company_snapshots: list[CompanyFinancialSnapshot]
